records.title: Permissible Deviations During Construction
records.text: Dimensional deviations in setbacks, ground coverage, and building height up to the limits specified in revised Table 2B (up to 10 percent for residential plots up to 240 sq.m and up to 5 percent for larger plots without violating FAR or road alignment) may be regularised upon payment of compounding fees prior to Occupancy Certificate.

records.title: Transferable Development Rights (TDR) and Premium FAR Loading
records.text: Plots abutting roads of 9.0 m to 12.0 m may load up to 0.20 Premium FAR; roads above 12.0 m to 18.0 m up to 0.40; and roads above 18.0 m up to 0.60 over the permissible base FAR under Chapter 11 and Table 11.1.

records.text: Minimum front, rear, and side setbacks for residential and commercial plots up to 4,000 sq.m shall be governed by revised Table 8 effective 5 January 2026, eliminating side setbacks on plots up to 60 sq.m and rationalising percentage setbacks on plots up to 240 sq.m.

records.title: Building Height and Stilt Floor Exemption
records.text: Building height shall be measured from the average level of the abutting street to the terrace slab. One or two stilt floors used exclusively for vehicle parking up to a cumulative height of 4.5 metres shall be exempt from FAR computation and included in total building height for setback and fire safety classification.

records.title: Ancillary Uses in R-Main
records.text: Ancillary commercial uses in Residential (Main) zone are permissible only in Ring I and Ring II on plots up to 240 sq.m abutting roads of 12.0 m width or more, restricted to 20 percent of built-up area or 50 sq.m whichever is less; in Ring III, commercial uses in R-Main require an 18.0 m road.

records.title: Storm Water Drain (Rajakaluve) Buffers
records.text: Every storm water drain in the Bengaluru Metropolitan Region shall maintain a no-construction buffer zone of 30 metres for Primary (Rajakaluve) drains, 15 metres for Secondary drains, and 10 metres for Tertiary drains measured from the outer edge of the drain wall.

records.title: Residential (Mixed) Zone [R-Mixed]
records.text: R-Mixed permits residential development alongside commercial and institutional uses subject to abutting road width thresholds under Table 10. [Amended (2018-08-14, rmp2015-zr-amend-2018:2.1): After regulation 4.2, insert the following requirement: in Residential (Mixed) zone [R-Mixed], standalone commercial buildings are permitted only where the abutting street has an existing clear width of 12.0 metres or more.]

records.title: Transport and Communication Zone [T&T]
records.text: T&T zone permits bus terminals, metro stations, depots, multi-level parking, telecommunication towers, and ancillary commercial/office transit-oriented development up to 25 percent of total built-up area with FAR up to 2.25.

records.title: Residential Layout and Villa Sub-division Norms
records.text: Every residential layout exceeding 4,000 sq.m shall earmark at least 15 percent of total area for parks and open spaces and 10 percent for civic amenities. [Amended (2015-03-20, rmp2015-zr-amend-2015-03:2.1): After regulation 6.1, insert the following proviso requiring minimum 9.0 m internal access driveways and 15 percent open space relinquishment in all gated villa and villament development plans.]

records.title: Parking Requirements and EV Charging Norms
records.text: Every building shall provide off-street parking per Table 23, with mandatory electric vehicle (EV) charging points for at least 20 percent of car and two-wheeler parking bays in all multi-dwelling and commercial buildings.
